modules.name: poker-engine
modules.description: Core poker game logic — deck, dealing, betting, pots, showdown

modules.name: gto-bot
modules.description: GTO-approximate rule engine for BOT decisions with preflop ranges and postflop decision tree

modules.name: gto-analyzer
modules.description: Post-hand GTO analysis — decision comparison, EV calculation, quality assessment, strategy explanations

modules.name: data-layer
modules.description: IndexedDB persistence via Dexie.js for sessions, hands, and decisions

modules.name: services
modules.description: Service layer implementing internal API contract, orchestrating engine/bot/analyzer/data

modules.name: stores
modules.description: Zustand state stores bridging services and UI components

modules.name: ui-table
modules.description: Poker table UI — 6-seat layout, cards, action panel, animations, result display

modules.name: ui-replay
modules.description: Post-hand replay UI — step-through, decision comparison, EV display, strategy explanations

modules.name: ui-history
modules.description: History browsing UI — paginated list, date filtering, session summary

modules.name: ui-shell
modules.description: App shell, routing, navigation, landing page, global components (toast, dialogs, guards)
